name: background-matched-secondary-v1
notes: No 30-second quiet loop. These rules do not alter the archived strict protocol.
Reject entire ABBA blocks; do not cherry-pick legs or repeatedly retry until favorable.
Raw process CPU time is primary; do not subtract background CPU from it.
WindowServer is a separate system-wide secondary outcome, not app-attributed GPU or battery power.
Instrumented frame lifetime/hitch passes are separate from uninstrumented CPU passes.
Capture PTS, display-link callback intervals, frame lifetime and hitch duration are different metrics.
Missing frame, GPU or energy data is unavailable, never zero.
No app animation, FPS, selection, content, source feature or priority is changed for measurement.
